All 288 channels pass the fixed on-pulse z>3 occupancy rule after the chosen dedispersion, making this event broadband under this replay metric rather than a narrowband-carrier morphology.
The 1.55-second width does not contradict published sub-second variability or approximately two-minute envelope duration because these describe different temporal scales and extraction definitions.
important_lesson_for_tesla_sweep: A genuinely ordered astrophysical source can contain a stable long clock plus broadband dispersed substructure on second and sub-second scales. Clock-like recurrence must therefore be separated from the morphology of the information-bearing waveform before any message analogy is entertained.
